text:
ops-bot: INCIDENT CREATED -> inference-runtime-high-tail-latency (sev2) · page: @oncall 
ops-bot: summary: sudden increase in tail latency and token cost for hosted API; initial signal from latency SLO and billing spike detector; affected models: redwood/open-llama-13b-quant and variants.

Laura Chen: I'm on it — jump in. seeing 95p latency > 3s across many requests. customers reporting truncation.

Ravi Patel: oncall here, pulled logs. early hypothesis: KV cache corruption after last night's quantization rollout (q4_0_opt) + batching changes. KV lookup failures showing hex garbage in first entries.

Diego Morales: context from ML infra — we rolled q4_0_opt to canary at 02:12 UTC, then promoted to prod at 03:05. Autoscaling also changed batch_window to 15ms around same time.

Mina Park: customer-impact check: Support seeing 3 enterprise customers with errors (500s) and repeated generation truncation. Escalated to account teams.

Customer Support: confirmed, accounts A and C report missing tokens and JSON parse errors in outputs. CS has created INC-8791 and notified account reps.

Ravi Patel: mitigation plan (live): 1) disable KV cache for affected model variants, 2) rollback batch_window to 10ms, 3) route critical customer traffic to Dedicated pool, 4) add temporary fallback to full-precision model. executing in that order.

Laura Chen: I'll run the disable for KV cache now. command: 
```
# disable prefix cache for model redwood/open-llama-13b-quant
rictl models update redwood/open-llama-13b-quant --kv-cache false --dry-run=false
```

ops-bot: deployment job started (job-id: 8f3a2) — rolling update across serving-nodes.

Diego Morales: Observing immediate drop in 95p latency after toggling KV cache on one node (staging). patch indicates malformed cache entries cause expensive fallback codepath.

Mina Park: CS update: Account A's errors reduced to occasional timeouts, no more truncation.

Evan Brooks: I'm preparing rollback for q4_0_opt on prod canary. Suggest we also disable automatic tensor serialization that was added in PR #4123.

Ravi Patel: rolling restart of serving-nodes in batch 2 to flush any persistent corrupted caches. Will pause autoscaler during restart to avoid flapping.

ops-bot: routing change applied: critical customers routed to dedicated-pool-3. (route-id: rt-221)

Laura Chen: After restarts + KV disabled + route changes: 95p latency back to ~450ms, token cost anomaly reduced. Keeping monitoring for 30m.

Mina Park: Customer impact summary (initial): ~3 customers impacted, peak error rate 8% for affected model, estimated revenue exposure $1.2k during incident window. CS is scheduling follow-up with each account.

Ravi Patel: timeline note: root cause likely incompatible serialization/format between new quantized weights and existing KV cache format — cache entries written by q4_0_opt workers use a new header which older runtime couldn't parse leading to thrown exceptions and heavy fallback logic that bloated latency.

Diego Morales: next immediate action: add safer cache migration codepath (detect header mismatch -> invalidate entry) rather than throwing. Filed internal ticket INT-3481.

Laura Chen: Good — we should also add a preflight check in rollout pipeline to detect KV header changes. Add to rollout checklist.

Evan Brooks: I'll open a PR to add header-tolerant parser + migration in runtime. Target: hotfix branch and canary within 24h. PR-4642 created.

Mina Park: Scheduling post-incident review: propose 2026-04-11 09:00 PT (team + SRE + ML infra + CS). Who can attend?

Ravi Patel: I can. Please include product so they can inform customers.

Diego Morales: can do. Add QA and devex — manifest tests should catch this.

Customer Support: CS will share customer timelines and impact notes in the postmortem.

ops-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED -> latency and errors mitigated; follow-up actions recorded.

Laura Chen: Post-incident action items (assignments):
- INT-3481: Runtime: tolerant-kv-parser + migration behavior (owner: Diego Morales, due: 2026-04-17)
- PR-4642: Hotfix PR for header-tolerant parser (owner: Evan Brooks, due: 2026-04-12)
- RC-221: Rollout checklist update to include KV header compatibility test (owner: Laura Chen, due: 2026-04-13)
- OPS-119: Deployment pipeline preflight gate for quantization promotions (owner: Ravi Patel, due: 2026-04-20)
- CS-Note: Customer follow-ups and compensation memo for impacted accounts (owner: Customer Support, due: 2026-04-12)

Mina Park: Add telemetry monitoring rule: alert if cache deserialization errors > 10/min. (owner: Mina Park, due: 2026-04-14)

Ravi Patel: Also track cost mitigation: add regression alert on token-cost anomalies for 24h after any rollout. Ticket OPS-120 (owner: Ravi Patel).

Diego Morales: Temporary mitigation steps documented: revert q4_0_opt promotion until hotfix is validated; add canary traffic limit to 1% for quantization profile changes.

Laura Chen: Postmortem meeting scheduled and calendar invites sent to participants. Please add any context or logs to INT-3481 in Jira.

Evan Brooks: I'll attach a minimal repro and sample corrupted cache blob to the ticket.

Customer Support: CS will prepare customer-facing postmortem summary and share drafts in #product once approved.

Ravi Patel: Closing notes: Good cross-team coordination. No data exfiltration; this was a serialization mismatch. Need better rollout guards between model binary changes and serving runtime.

Laura Chen: Marking incident as follow-up-required. Reopen if we see recurrence. :white_check_mark:
